Your computer. Your assistant.

Vilna OS is a free system built on Linux, with a built-in AI assistant, Gloxi. It thinks on your computer and acts only with your permission.

It thinks on your computer

Gloxi uses a small model right on your computer, and your words do not leave it. It turns to the cloud only if you switch it on and agree, and before anything is sent, sensitive details are hidden on your own computer.

Nothing without your permission

A security layer stands between Gloxi and your computer. A risky action waits until you say yes. You can see what happened and put things back if you change your mind.

If an update goes wrong, you can go back

An update either lands in full or not at all. If something goes wrong, you can return the computer to how it was before, as if you had yesterday back.

Study it, change it, pass it on

Vilna OS and Gloxi, security layer included, are free software (GPL-3.0-or-later): you can see how they are made, change them and share them. The system comes with the Tinta Office programs.

Who it is for

For people who want an assistant on their computer without giving up control. Vilna OS is built on Linux (openSUSE Aeon): a computer system in the same role as Windows or macOS, except that you can study it and change it. Anyone can use it, from any country. The project's servers are in Europe. It speaks 10 languages today, and 15 soon.

First steps

The first step is Gloxi 0.1 preview: the assistant as an app for any Linux with GNOME. You can already build it from source, and the ready package comes out in January 2027. Vilna OS itself follows in 2027, first as a closed trial with a small group.
